group_label: Extra missions (Nadesico B, Ra Cailum, White Fang...)

glossary.role: Militant anti-Earth colony organization, later led by Zechs Merquise
Londo Bell flagship battleship (Bright Noa's ship) in CCA.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz

glossary.role: Prototype high-performance mobile suit (OZ-00MS), Zechs's machine

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: NS-955B Nadesico B, second-generation Nadesico-class battleship of the UESF captained by Ruri

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.role: Female lead; heir of the Sanc Kingdom (real name Relena Peacecraft), Zechs's younger sister, and a pacifist leader.
glossary.personality: Idealistic, determined pacifist; dignified and unafraid to confront soldiers.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Ace pilot (Tallgeese, Tallgeese III); former OZ officer and White Fang leader; Preventer agent ('Preventer Wind') in Endless Waltz. True identity Milliardo Peacecraft, Relena's older brother.
glossary.personality: Proud, chivalrous and self-loathing; a brilliant pilot torn between knightly ideals and soldiering. Speaks with formal dignity.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Mobile suit pilot and former OZ Specials instructor; Preventer agent ('Preventer Fire'); Zechs's devoted partner. ACE2 calls her ノイン特尉 (Preventer rank).
glossary.personality: Mature, composed, slightly tomboyish; an idealist who dislikes war, but fights hard for those she believes in. Fiercely loyal to Zechs.

glossary.role: Organization of the Zodiac: elite secret society/military organization inside the Alliance, led by Treize Khushrenada
